title: A New ChatGPT Work Tool Reference Puts the Focus on Operational Clarity
dek: A Hacker News-linked reference for ChatGPT work tools and skills signals continued demand for clearer documentation around how AI systems are used in day-to-day work.
socialCaption: A new “ChatGPT Work Tool and Skill Reference” shared on Hacker News highlights a practical adoption challenge: AI value depends on clear tool boundaries, tested workflows and accountable human review—not just model access.
